Peter grapples with the aftermath of recent events as Olivia desperately searches for an ally. Meanwhile, the Team discovers a critical device that communicates between universes.
When a victim has his heart extracted, it's just the beginning of a series of mysterious and reanimating events. Meanwhile, Peter comes to terms with his relationship with Olivia.
In the midseason premiere, an Observer makes contact with the Fringe Team to help rectify a mistake. Meanwhile, Walter befriends one of his musical heroes (CHRISTOPHER LLOYD).
When the Fringe Team visits Massive Dynamic's assembly of the doomsday device, Walter becomes concerned for Peter's wellbeing — so he turns to Nina for help.
The Fringe team investigates an intense case when a scientist falls dead after ingesting a lethal cloud of blue powder, and his bones disintegrate in his body.
The Alternate Fringe team investigates a bioterrorist armed with an insect that has a taste for human flesh. And Walternate discovers a line he will not cross.
A series of Fringe events leads the team to the home of a woman grieving over the death of her husband, while Peter and Olivia try to repair the emotional rift between them.

Clarke, Bellamy, Octavia and Jasper hit a tragic roadblock. Meanwhile, Raven and Monty make an important discovery.

In the second half of the two-part season finale, everyone prepares for a final showdown as they face the reality of their tragic situation in the epic & mind-bending conclusion.

As tensions rise in Arkadia and Polis, Jaha leads Clarke and Bellamy down a road toward possible salvation.
While Abby leads a team to a distant location, hoping to find answers, the continued struggles with leadership and trust in Arkadia and Polis take a violent turn.
